description: - Incoming Ordering: Sort newly assigned unscheduled tasks by descending reward, then smaller task ID.
- Segment Search: For consecutive 3-observation segments (restricted to broken-edge endpoints if broken edges exist),
try both cyclic reorderings placing incoming tasks first.
- Acceptance: Return feasible issued trial with highest profit; return null if no broken edges, no incoming tasks,
or no feasible trial within evaluation limit.
